notes.title: 1.2.7 - Leaderboard Bug Fix
notes.notes:
I've just published an update which should fix some of the problems we've been experiencing with the leaderboards. 
Unfortunately this means I've had to wipe the leaderboards once again, as I haven't been able to filter out the false times which were posted due to the error.

Please let me know if you have any more problems with the leaderboards!

notes.title: 1.2.5 - Style Update
notes.notes:
I've updated two of the style options to be more visually friendly. 
A few reviews mentioned that they were much too bright to play comfortably! 

Please let me know how you find them.

notes.title: 1.2.3 - Keyboard Bug Fix
notes.notes:
I've just remapped some of the keyboard shortcuts, as I was informed about a bug.

Instead of pressing 1 and 2, the keyboard shortcuts for the restart and hint buttons are now CTRL and SHIFT. 
The in-game advisory text has also been updated to remind us of these changes.

notes.title: 1.12 - UI Update
notes.notes:
A minor update, replacing the volume control text entry boxes with clickable +/- buttons.
Some behind-the-scenes code refactoring for on-screen UI icons.

notes.title: 1.11 - UI Update
notes.notes:
I've made a slight adjustment to the default colour scheme. 
The colours for 'hint' squares are now a little deeper, with the intention of making the game easier on the eyes. 
Let me know how you find it!

notes.title: 1.0.9 - Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Greetings, minesweepers!

I've finally fixed a bug which has been troubling us for some time.
From version 1.0.9, your first click will always reveal a blank tile.
This will help us avoid the frustrating situation of needing to guess at the beginning of a game.

Please let me know about any other bugs you experience.

notes.title: 1.0.5 - Hex Mode Bugfix, Clock Transparency
notes.notes:
-Bug fixed in Hex mode: not all blank tiles were revealed when clicking.

-Timer can now be toggled to transparent. Click on it before or during the game to toggle its transparency.

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Bug fixes and new style
notes.notes:
Fixed bug which inhibited unlocking multiple achievements in the same match

Optimised main menu to load faster

Balanced difficulty in hex mode so it's more challenging

Fixed sound-effect bug which lagged sound on tile reveal

Added extra style option

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Localisation and Leaderboard Bugfix
notes.notes:
-French, German, Spanish and Portuguese languages added

-Leaderboard bug fixed
